todoContent: Explore current project state - read contracts and existing firmware
functionalSummary: Explored the MyActuator ESP32 firmware project state by reading all motor contracts and existing codebase structure.
detailSummary: Read all six motor contracts (CEM, RH, RMD_H, RMD_X, MCP2515 CAN, ESP32 Firmware) and explored the existing ESP32 firmware structure. The codebase uses a layered architecture: hardware drivers (mcp2515_can, rs485) → bus abstraction (can_bus) → motor drivers (rmd_x_driver, rh_driver, cem_driver) → protocol layer (pal) → application (motor_controller, main). Configuration is split across config.h, constants.h, and types.h. Logger uses static class members. No new symbols were created; only exploration occurred. File modification attempts on logger.h/cpp failed due to existing file conflicts, indicating the files were already populated.
keyPatterns: Driver pattern: Each motor type (rmd_x, rh, cem) has separate driver files with .h/.cpp pairs
CAN bus abstraction: can_bus.h/cpp wraps MCP2515 hardware driver
Protocol layer: pal.cpp/h implements unified protocol over CAN/RS485
Logging: Logger class with static _level and _timestamp members in utils/logger
Configuration: config.h/cpp for project settings, constants.h for magic numbers
Types: types.h contains shared type definitions across the codebase
verification: No tests executed; exploration phase only
